in_hebrew.name: Gerstner
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gerstner הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German words 'ger' meaning spear and 'stern' meaning bearer. This name was given to warriors and knights, symbolizing strength and bravery.
